summary.method: One exact-phrase Google query (Bright Data SERP API) per exercise using its most distinctive 8-12 word window; if nothing matched, one keyword query restricted to study sites. A result counts as a leak when it is on a homework-help site, its title+snippet match the exercise at >= 0.5, and it contains the exercise's ask (>= 60% of its content words), so shared phrases alone don't count. Answer signal = the snippet mentions an answer, solution, solved, step-by-step, or expert-verified; we never open paywalled pages.
caveats: Search results vary by day and region; this is one snapshot.
Match scores measure text overlap, not proof that the page holds the same question or a correct answer.
Calculus has 12 exercises, not 20 (its review pages are mostly symbolic).
Exercises are OpenStax excerpts (<= 125 chars); sites that paraphrase questions are undercounted.
